title: Remove retired entry-state dependency from intraday research owner
objective: Resolve the now-dead dependency in the existing intraday execution research owner where classify() can leave REGIME_NOT_ACTIVE only when entry_state equals the retired GRADUATED_ALTCOIN_TOPUP_ACTIVE observer state. Preserve the 12 July retirement and current non-binding research authority. Reuse an existing explicit research-only eligibility/context contract if one already exists; otherwise fail closed and document the unresolved authority gap rather than inventing a new market gate, threshold or promotion rule. Coordinate with open PR #665 and stop as a clean no-op if that PR resolves the defect before remediation starts.
allowed_change_scope: 04_MARKET_LEARNING/intraday_execution/PROTOCOL.md only if needed to keep documentation aligned with existing research-only authority
tests/intraday_execution/directly related intraday eligibility and authority tests
the open PR #665 branch only if fresh-state discovery confirms it is still the active overlapping owner and repository tooling supports safe continuation there

evidence.summary: Current classify() returns REGIME_NOT_ACTIVE unless entry_state is GRADUATED_ALTCOIN_TOPUP_ACTIVE, making all later intraday research states unreachable when that observer state is retired.
Merged measurement-validity remediation binds the legacy entry observer to the 12 July retirement so source-quality improvement alone cannot promote GRADUATED_ALTCOIN_TOPUP_ACTIVE.
Canonical 12 July verdict retires the frozen breadth predictive gate at zero weight and keeps graduated alt deployment forward-only/not promotion-ready.

Open overlapping intraday-confidence PR substantially extends the same owner but its current branch still retains the retired entry-state dependency. A review comment documents the blocking audit finding.
Intraday execution owner is explicitly research-only with no canonical market-state or portfolio authority; any repair must preserve those boundaries.

reproduction: On fresh main and the current head of open PR #665, inspect scripts/intraday_execution/intraday_execution_research.py::classify(). Confirm the first guard returns REGIME_NOT_ACTIVE unless obs.entry_state == GRADUATED_ALTCOIN_TOPUP_ACTIVE. Then inspect current Entry Signal owner semantics after PR #657 and the 12 July canonical breadth verdict. Confirm the legacy ACTIVE state is not promotion-ready under current authority. If #665 or another already-merged owner has removed this dependency using an explicit pre-existing research-only eligibility contract without re-enabling retired breadth authority, stop as clean no-op.

positive: A fixture with valid existing non-binding research context can reach the intraday research warmup/classification path without requiring GRADUATED_ALTCOIN_TOPUP_ACTIVE, but only if a pre-existing repository authority explicitly permits that research eligibility.
The intraday owner remains research_only=true, portfolio_execution=false and canonical_market_state=false after the repair.
Existing direction-confidence functionality from #665, if present at remediation time, remains shadow-only and cannot substitute as entry/regime permission.
Focused tests prove the owner is not structurally dead solely because the legacy Entry Signal observer was correctly retired.
negative: A proxy-only breadth pattern, legacy Entry Signal criteria, or GRADUATED_ALTCOIN_TOPUP_ACTIVE label cannot independently authorize intraday research eligibility or portfolio action.
Do not re-enable, reinterpret or promote the retired 12 July breadth predictive gate or graduated-alt deployment state.
Do not invent a new market threshold, entry gate, model weight, canonical state, portfolio rule or policy semantic to make the owner reachable.
Do not weaken fail-closed behavior when no explicit existing research-only eligibility authority can be identified.
Do not overwrite or conflict with open PR #665; if its current branch resolves the defect before execution, terminate as clean no-op.

clean_noop_condition: Open PR #665 or another current-main change already removes the retired dependency while preserving 12 July retirement and research-only authority, or fresh-state discovery proves the intraday owner is intentionally retired/superseded.
stop_condition: Stop without code changes if the candidate hash/status/authority changed, #665 resolves the defect first, the intraday owner is intentionally superseded, or no pre-existing research-only eligibility authority exists and repair would require a new market/policy rule.
escalation_condition: Escalate to FRAMEWORK_OWNER if making the intraday owner reachable requires any new market gate, threshold, canonical authority, portfolio logic, API budget or new policy semantics rather than a bounded code remediation to existing research-only authority.
